examples.label: Contact form with a message box
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-form-wrapper" site="Global" for={%{}} id="contact-form" space="medium" padding="medium" rounded="large" action_wrapper_class="pt-2">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="contact-name" name="name" value="" label="Your name" />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-email-field" site="Global" id="contact-email" name="email" value="" label="Email address" description="We only use this to reply to you." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="contact-message" name="message" value="" label="How can we help?" rows="5" />
  <:actions>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="submit" color="primary">Send message</.component>
  </:actions>
</.component>

examples.label: Support ticket form with a priority select
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-form-wrapper" site="Global" for={%{}} id="ticket-form" space="medium" padding="medium" rounded="medium" action_wrapper_class="flex gap-3 pt-2">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="ticket-subject" name="subject" value="" label="Subject" />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-native-select" site="Global" id="ticket-priority" name="priority" label="How urgent is it?">
    <:option value="low">Low — answer when you can</:option>
    <:option value="normal" selected={true}>Normal — within a working day</:option>
    <:option value="urgent">Urgent — the site is down</:option>
  </.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="ticket-details" name="details" value="" label="What happened?" rows="6" description="Paste the exact error message if you saw one." />
  <:actions>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="submit" color="primary">Open ticket</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="reset" variant="outline" color="natural">Clear the form</.component>
  </:actions>
</.component>
